statement_summary: Maintain a documented security program
Owner designated security lead and CMMC affirming official in writing
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; High risks never accepted as they are
Annual self-assessment with periodic outside review
No SPRS affirmation unless all 15 requirements are MET; annual repeat
Annual policy review
Written, time-limited exceptions; none for [FAR] rules
Supplier list with data received and NDA or flowdown date
Processors get PO and spec only; flowdown and Level 1 check before any FCI
OEM drawings only to OEM-approved parties under NDA
Annual review of the productivity suite SOC 2 report and customer controls
Owner-started, watched remote support; unattended access off
Unique accounts; no shared credentials
Standard user account for daily work
Authenticator-app MFA wherever offered
Unique 14-character passphrases; defaults changed before use
Written account approval; same-day removal; quarterly review
Sealed emergency access sheet with the designated emergency contact
Monthly review of sign-in history and router device list
Three-level data classification
Restricted data only in approved locations; never in consumer apps or AI tools
Screen every drawing package for CUI, ITAR, and EAR markings before download
Named-person sharing links with 30-day expiry
Read-only released programs with hashes; compare before each OEM run
Weekly backup the laptop cannot overwrite; quarterly test restore
Only the owner posts; photo check before posting; quarterly website review
Shred paper; wipe or certify destruction of devices and sticks; record each disposal
Six-year retention of security and CMMC records; SQA periods for quality records
Updates and antivirus on; monthly CAM and router firmware check
Laptop and VMC on their own segment; guest Wi-Fi; share password
Shop-labeled USB sticks only; service media scanned first
Visitor log kept one year; escort; drawings covered; key list
AI tools only after P10 approval; AI G-code simulated and dry-run
Annual security course for the owner
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery time
Customer notices on time (72 hours aerospace; 5 business days OEM)
No ransom without legal advice and an OFAC check
Written overflow arrangement with a nearby shop, subject to customer approval
